cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740001:.text: General Perseus, we can't break through!

cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740002:.text: Damn, they were prepared for us...

cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740003:.text: All units! Fall back! To the Primal Shrine!
cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740003:.source_cn: 都听令！先撤退！去狩猎神殿！

say:5:1510741001:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Perseus ordered his soldiers to attack the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>!
say:5:1510741001:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Perseus ordered his soldiers to attack the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>!
say:5:1510741001:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Perseus ordered his soldiers to attack the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>!

say:7:1510741002:0.text: Ha! This is good news! The entire way from here to the shrine is guarded by our people. They won't get past us easily. We can press our advantage!
say:7:1510741002:0.source_cn: 这是个好消息！从这里到神殿一路上都有我们的守卫，没那么...

choice_prompt:8:1510741002.text: Ha! This is good news! The entire way from here to the shrine is guarded by our people. They won't get past us easily. We can press our advantage!
choice_prompt:8:1510741002.source_cn: 这是个好消息！从这里到神殿一路上都有我们的守卫，没那么容易躲过去，我们正好乘胜追击！

say:9:1510741003:0.text: The Great Herdmaster is going to intervene personally?!
say:9:1510741003:0.source_cn: 伟大的兽群之主要亲自出手？！那我们……
say:9:1510741003:0.male: The Great Herdmaster is going to intervene personally?!
say:9:1510741003:0.female: The Great Herdmaster is going to intervene personally?!

say:10:1510741004:0.text: The Herdmaster has spoken. All you need to do is obey his divine will.
say:10:1510741004:0.source_cn: 兽群之主已经发话，你们只需要遵守神谕。
say:10:1510741004:0.male: The Herdmaster has spoken. All you need to do is obey his divine will.
say:10:1510741004:0.female: The Herdmaster has spoken. All you need to do is obey her divine will.

say:12:1510741005:0.text: The Halians are cunning. Stay on guard in case they have another trick up their sleeve.
say:12:1510741005:0.source_cn: 呼临人狡诈，继续守备，以防后招。

say:13:1510741006:0.text: Understood! May your spears stay ever sharp!
say:13:1510741006:0.source_cn: 是……我们服从！愿你们的矛永远锋利！
say:13:1510741006:0.male: Understood! May your spears stay ever sharp!
say:13:1510741006:0.female: Understood! May your spears stay ever sharp!

choice:8:0:1.text: You stay here and protect Veilwatch Camp.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 你们留下来保护逐影营地
choice:8:0:1.male: You stay here and protect Veilwatch Camp.
choice:8:0:1.female: You stay here and protect Veilwatch Camp.

narration:16:15010738:0.text: After failing to breach the Veilwatch Camp, the Halian soldiers shift their focus to the Primal Shrine. Nazrik throws a tracking spear at Perseus during his retreat.
narration:16:15010738:0.source_cn: 见逐影营地攻略不下，呼临士兵转战狩猎神殿。呼临撤退之际...
